model.shadow.review.challenge-transition: A self-digest and local confirmation do not authenticate origin or authority.
A separate caller-owned local root is not independently operated external retention.
Caller-owned files can be deleted or replaced.
Relative detection does not prevent source or retention-root rollback.

state.local.file-fsync.directory-hardwar: File fsync does not establish directory-entry hardware or power-loss durability.

model.shadow.review.challenge-transition: Synthetic roots and processes remain under one test controller.
No independent principals or anti-collusion evidence exists.
Confirmation strings do not prove a human participated.
Library calls do not authenticate the invoking host or actor.
Other roots and withheld branches remain possible.
Two local roots are not a globally consistent log.
Equal bracketing reads are not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
